Read the full [AICE JavaScript Code Review Standards](references/javascript-review-standards.md) before reviewing any JavaScript pull request.

This guide governs how a review is conducted — severity, what's worth flagging, tone, comment format. It does not restate what the code itself should look like: for that, defer to the `javascript-style-guide` and `javascript-testing-standards` skills, and cite the specific section when flagging a violation of one of them.
